info.timeAllocation: Study hour (150h) = 45 contact hours (60 sessions) + 105 hours self-study (including projects preparation)
info.description:
This course instructs students how to apply translation techniques in dealing with interlingual translation of different types of texts including administrative forms and documents (degrees, certificate, contracts..); business forms and documents (business transaction agreement, financial statements); technical news and documents; socio-cultural news and documents.
After taking this course, students should be able to:
- Demonstrate a clear understanding of different types and formats of texts
- Demonstrate a clear understanding terms used the administrative documents, technical, economic, scientific, socio-cultural news and documents...
- Translate the mentioned kinds of news and documents from Vietnamese into English and vice-versa.
- Use Gen-AI tools to enhance translation quality and facilitate translation processes
info.studentTasks:
- Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination
'- Actively participate in class activities
'- Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class
'- Use their own laptops in class only for learning purposes
'- Read the theory in advance
'- Use Gen-AI tools in an appropriate and ethical manner
